title: TRACE
description: An intruder signature (ID 000) tunnelled into BLACKVAULT via RELAY-7. Follow the data stream back to its source.
goal: Trace the intruder's tunnel on RELAY-7.
hint: connect relay_7, read the tunnel log, then run 'trace' and click the highlighted packet.
story_start: MIRA: "RELAY-7 is a transit node, nothing lives there. But traffic remembers. Follow it."
MIRA: "When the trace begins, packets will race across your screen. Click the marked one before it escapes."

objectives.hint: Type: trace — click the glowing packet in the stream.

story_end: The tunnel ends at ORBITAL — a satellite relay platform with a very loud signature.

messages.text: Heard you're running traces without proper hardware. Amateur. Type 'shop' — I've got gear. Also: hi. I'm VECTOR.
Whoever is behind ID 000 has been inside NEXUS far longer than we thought. Be careful, {player}.
